adaptive_armor.d: Defense grows by +1 every 2 seconds you go without taking damage, up to +10 after 20 seconds. Resets to zero the instant you're hit.

afterburner.d: While airborne: +25% ranged damage, +12% ranged crit chance and +10% ranged attack speed. Firing a ranged weapon in the air pushes you backwards, opposite your aim. Slower, heavier weapons push harder. You take no fall damage and gain +25% wing flight time.

ambush.d: Stand still for 2 seconds to prime your next melee hit. The primed hit deals +25% bonus damage based on the weapon's base damage.

apex_hunter.d: Ranged hits against a boss build a mark

apex_predator.d: Damage scales up the lower the target's HP is, up to +50% bonus damage against an enemy on the brink of death.

arcane_singularity.d: Magic hits build up to 8 charges. At full charge, your next magic hit opens a vortex for 3 seconds, pulling enemies within 300 pixels toward its core and dealing 20 magic damage every 0.5 seconds.

arcane_spark.d: Magic hits deal 6 bonus magic damage on-hit.

astral_siphon.d: Magic crits restore 5 HP and 15 mana.

autopilot.d: Your Pod becomes Pod 153 and heals the lowest-health nearby player for 5 HP per second.

type_s_synchronizer_protocol.d: Every 10 seconds, cycles polarity between Offensive Overclock (+15% damage, +10% crit, +10 armor penetration, but halts natural life regeneration) and Restorative Nano-Repair (+15 defense, +12 life regen, +15% movement speed, but -15% damage).

type_b_berserker_protocol.d: While below 50% HP, enter Berserk Overclock: gain +40% damage, +15% movement speed, and +10% attack speed. Potion sickness duration is increased by +15 seconds.

type_d_dreadnought_protocol.d: Grants +20 defense and 15% damage reduction, but reduces outgoing damage by 15%. Taking 120 cumulative damage detonates a kinetic shockwave dealing 60 damage with violent knockback, and activates a 1.5 seconds Energy Barrier that negates all incoming damage.

bait_master.d: Fishing bait grants +30% more fishing power than normal.

berserker.d: While below 50% HP, melee hits deal +20% bonus damage.

blade_dance.d: Active: Press its hotkey with a melee weapon in hand to become invulnerable for 2 seconds while you blink between nearby enemies, cutting each one you reach for 90 damage (8 slashes). 50 seconds cooldown.

bloodletter.d: Melee crits make enemies bleed, dealing 3 damage per second for 5 seconds.

brewers_instinct.d: Buff potions have a 40% chance to last 50% longer.

bulwark.d: Going 10 seconds without taking damage charges a shield that completely blocks your next hit, then resets and must recharge.

callout.d: Your hits mark enemies for 5 seconds, shown as a [cmark:x] above them. Marked enemies take +10% damage from your teammates.

celestial_pull.d: Increases pickup range for Mana Stars by 15 tiles.

chain_lightning.d: Melee hits deal 15 damage on-hit and chain electricity to up to 2 nearby enemies, dealing 50% of your on-hit damage.

chaos_rounds.d: Ranged hits apply a random debuff for 3 seconds: On Fire, Frostburn, Poisoned, Venom or Ichor.

chronobreak.d: Active: Press its hotkey to rewind you and nearby teammates to where they stood 4 seconds ago, restoring HP up to what they had then. It never lowers anyone's HP. Rewound players are invulnerable for 0.5 seconds. 120 seconds cooldown.

cleanse.d: Active: Press its hotkey to remove all debuffs from nearby teammates and throw them onto nearby enemies instead. 15 seconds cooldown.

cleansing_strike.d: Melee crits remove one active debuff from yourself, if you have any.

combat_medic.d: Nearby teammates regenerate 1.5 HP per second.

contact_charge.d: True melee hits grant +20% Overclock charge to your Medi Gun, at most once every 2 seconds.

corrosive_tip.d: The Medi Gun siphon beam deals +50% damage.

critical_surge.d: Crits have a 40% chance to deal a bonus on-hit strike for 25% of the weapon's base damage.

danger_close.d: Active: Press its hotkey to mark your cursor. After 1.5 seconds, 20 shells rain down on it, each exploding for 45 damage and setting enemies on fire. 45 seconds cooldown.

dark_omen.d: During a Blood Moon, all damage dealt is increased by +20% and 6% of damage dealt is returned as healing. During a Solar Eclipse, movement speed is increased by 20% and incoming damage is reduced by 12%.

dead_weight.d: The slower your melee weapon, the harder it hits, up to +30% damage and 10 armor penetration. Hits with slow weapons also slam the ground, hurling nearby enemies away. 0.6 seconds cooldown.

deadeye.d: Consecutive ranged hits on the same enemy build +2% crit chance per hit, up to +16% crit chance at 8 stacks. Switching targets resets the stacks.

debug_full_crit.d: Testing only. Guarantees 100% crit chance on all weapons.

demolition_expert.d: Explosive hits (bombs, dynamite, rocket launchers, grenade launchers) deal +20% bonus damage.

discount_rod.d: Active: Press its hotkey to teleport to your cursor (up to 25 tiles away), leaving an afterimage that explodes after 1 second. 8 seconds cooldown.

double_tip.d: Magic casts fire an additional Twin Harmonic Spell dealing 35% damage. Alternating casts between different magic weapons triggers Hyper-Weave for 5 seconds, boosting twin damage to 60%, granting +15% magic damage, and reducing mana cost by -50%.

echo_chamber.d: Firing a ranged projectile also fires an echo shot for 20% damage. Echo shots trigger on-hit effects at 50% effectiveness.

eldritch_covenant.d: Spending mana builds corruption. At full corruption, your next magic hit opens an eldritch eye for 4 seconds, firing lasers that deal 40 damage.

emergency_aid.d: You and nearby teammates below 40% HP regenerate 3 HP per second.

employee_of_the_month.d: Your highest-damage minion wears a gold star and deals +40% damage.

eternal_flame.d: Permanently immune to fire-based debuffs (On Fire!, Hellfire, Cursed Inferno, Shadowflame, Burning). Each time one would have been applied, gain +15% magic damage for 4 seconds instead.

eternal_legion.d: Permanently grants +1 max minion slot and +1 max sentry slot.

featherfall.d: Fall damage is reduced by 50%. Landing from a significant fall grants +30% movement speed for 2 seconds.

festering_wounds.d: Damage Over Time effects deal 50% more damage.

fetch.d: Items dropped by enemies your summons kill fly straight to you.

fight_or_flight.d: While below 50% HP, gain +10% movement speed.

final_stand.d: Dropping below 20% HP grants +40 defense and full knockback immunity for 5 seconds. 60 second cooldown.

floor_is_lava.d: Ranged explosions splash Napalm Plasma outward. The plasma lands on the ground as several pools (and sometimes sticks to a wall) that burn for 4 seconds, dealing continuous 22 fire damage. Enemies standing in the plasma (pools or wall flames) suffer Thermite Melt: ignoring 20 defense, taking +15% ranged damage from all sources, and being slowed by 25%. You take 75% less self-damage from your own explosives.

focus_directive.d: Whips grant +6 summon tag damage to hit enemies.

fortunes_favor.d: Grants +10% Fortune (+0.05 World Luck & +10% lucky trigger chances across all augments). Also slowly regenerates 1 HP every 4 seconds on its own.

frenzied_assault.d: Melee crits grant a stacking attack speed buff: +7% per stack, up to +35% at 5 stacks. Stacks reset after 3 seconds.

frost_touch.d: Magic crits apply Frostburn for 4 seconds.

frostbound.d: Magic hits against an already Frostburned enemy deal +25% bonus damage, based on the weapon's base damage. Requires the enemy to have Frostburn applied.

get_excited.d: After killing an enemy, gain +8% movement speed for 2 seconds, stacking up to +24% movement speed.

get_over_here.d: Active: Press its hotkey to hook the nearest teammate within 1500 pixels and yank them to your side. They take 50% less damage for 2 seconds after landing. 60 seconds cooldown.

godslayer_blade.d: Melee crits summon a falling sword that deals 75% of base weapon damage to the target and nearby enemies. Enemies struck are inflicted with Ichor for 2 seconds. 2 seconds cooldown.

grand_entrance.d: Summoning a minion or sentry calls down lightning on it, dealing 50% of its damage to nearby enemies it can see and knocking them back.

grapple_master.d: Releasing your grappling hook grants +25% movement speed for 4 seconds.

tombstone_boost.d: Every tombstone within 30 tiles of you gives +3% damage to all your attacks, up to +30% damage from 10 tombstones.

pellet_burst.d: When 2 or more pellets of one shot hit the same enemy, they burst for 75% of their damage in a small area around it.

guardians_wrath.d: While below 30% HP, gain +15 defense and reduce incoming damage by 20%, but outgoing damage is reduced by 15% during that same window.

gun_go_brrr.d: The longer you hold fire, the more heat builds, up to +60% attack speed. At max heat your gun jams for 2 seconds.

headhunter.d: Ranged crits executes enemies below 15% HP, regardless of the hit's normal damage. Does not work on bosses.

heart_drop.d: While missing HP, enemy kills have +10% chance heart drop chance.

hex_detonation.d: Magic hits stack Hex on enemies, up to 5 stacks for 6 seconds. The next magic hit on a fully hexed enemy detonates it, dealing 200% of that hit's damage to nearby enemies.

hit_me_here.d: Ranged hits scan the target, projecting a glowing cybernetic weakpoint reticle for 4 seconds. Hitting the weakpoint guarantees a Critical Strike that ignores 100% defense, ruptures the target, and grants +15% movement speed for 2 seconds.

hunters_pace.d: Ranged hits give +15% movement speed for 2 seconds.

infernos_heart.d: 8 consecutive magic hits within 0.5 seconds of each other charge a burst

auto_fishing.d: While you hold a fishing pole, the line reels in by itself the moment a fish bites, and then it casts again toward your cursor.

iron_will.d: After you're hit, gain +8 defense for 3 seconds. 30 seconds cooldown.

ironclad_aura.d: Nearby teammates gain +8 defense while you are within range.

ironclad_will.d: Melee hits have a 40% chance to ignore 100% of enemy defense.

keen_eye.d: Nearby teammates gain +8% critical strike chance.

kickback.d: Each shotgun or rocket launcher shot adds a stack (max 8). Every stack gives those weapons +15% damage. Stacks reset after 3 seconds without firing one. Firing one also pushes you backwards, opposite your aim, and much harder up or down than sideways. Rocket launchers kick harder than shotguns.

death_blast.d: When a hit would kill you, you refuse to die: for 5 seconds your health stays at 0, nothing can hurt you, and you deal +100% damage with +50% attack speed. Then you die in a small blast that hurts enemies nearby. 180 seconds cooldown.

last_rites.d: When a nearby teammate drops below 20% HP, grant them 3 seconds of invulnerability.

last_stand.d: A killing blow instead leaves you at 1 HP, with brief invulnerability. 3 minutes cooldown.

leftovers.d: When a melee hit kills an enemy, the damage left over hits the nearest other enemy.

lifeline.d: When a nearby teammate would die, they survive on 1 HP instead.

long_distance_relationship.d: Active: Press its hotkey to open a portal at your cursor for 8 seconds. Your magic spells launch from the portal toward your cursor instead of from you. Portal spells deal up to +50% damage, more the farther the portal is from you, and cost half the mana. 20 seconds cooldown.

lucky_find.d: Grants +5% Fortune (World Luck & lucky trigger chance). Defeated enemies have a 25% chance to drop extra coins.

lucky_strike.d: Grants +5% Fortune (World Luck & lucky trigger chance). Any crit has a 40% chance to deal a second strike for the same damage.

tree_bonus.d: Wood from the trees you chop has a 30% chance to drop twice. Trees might be hiding a little something for you.

mana_reflux.d: When you take damage, restore mana equal to 35% of the damage taken.

marionette.d: Your minions are locked to your mouse cursor instead of following you. Minions deal +15% damage.

martyrs_resolve.d: Nearby teammates take 15% reduced damage. You take 15% increased damage.

master_angler.d: Grants +10 fishing power and opening crates has a 20% chance for bonus loot.

mending_aura.d: While standing still, heal 5 HP every second.

meteor_strike.d: Crits against bosses have a 40% chance to call down a bonus strike dealing 2.5% of the boss's maximum HP.

minion_momentum.d: Minion hits build a stacking +1% bonus damage per hit, up to +20% bonus damage at 20 stacks, as long as the same minion type stays active. Switching to a different summon weapon resets the stack.

mirror_image.d: Incoming hits have a 15% chance to be completely avoided, taking zero damage, followed by a brief 1.33 seconds window of invincibility. Applies to any damage source.

momentum_crash.d: Dashing grants 75% reduced damage taken for 0.25 seconds. Landing a melee hit during this window deals +30% bonus damage and applies Confused for 1.5 seconds.

momentum_swing.d: Hitting the same enemy repeatedly within 1.5 seconds builds +3% bonus damage per stack, up to +15% bonus damage at 5 stacks. Switching targets or waiting too long resets the stacks.

necromancers_court.d: Summon kills raise ghost minions for 6 seconds, each dealing 5 damage.

neural_linkage.d: While you have an active minion, reduce incoming damage by 20%. Taking damage commands your nearest minion to counter-dash the attacker for 200% minion damage. 2 seconds counter cooldown.

one_in_the_chamber.d: Pausing attack for 0.7 seconds chambers a Hyper-Velocity Round. The next shot gains +100% velocity, pierces 3 additional enemies, and deals +35% damage.

opportunist.d: Melee hits against an airborne enemy (knocked into the air or naturally flying) deal +20% bonus damage, based on the weapon's base damage.

pod_ore.d: Your Pod becomes Pod 311. Active: Press its hotkey and your Pod sniffs out the nearest ore, giving you a riddle about it and an arrow to follow. 6 seconds cooldown.

ore_bonus.d: Every ore you mine has a 30% chance to drop twice.

overcharge.d: Magic weapons cost double mana per cast, but deal +40% bonus damage.

overcharge_round.d: Consecutive ranged hits build a stacking on-hit proc, +1 stack per hit up to 10, resetting after 1 second without a hit. The proc deals 5 plus 3 per stack, up to 35 at full charge.

overwhelm.d: Hitting the same enemy 3 times within 1.5 seconds applies Confused for 1 second. Switching targets or waiting too long resets the count.

party_poppers.d: Rockets and explosive ranged weapons gain +15% damage and a +30% blast radius. When an explosive detonates, it releases 4 bouncy micro-bomblets that explode on contact.

mana_buffer.d: Half of every hit you take is paid from your mana instead of your life, while you have mana.

pod_shoot.d: Your Pod becomes Pod 218 and shoots a small bolt at the nearest enemy every 1 second.

phase_round.d: Arrows and bullets can pass through walls.

phoenix_heart.d: A killing blow instead restores you to max HP, with 3 seconds of invulnerability.

pied_piper.d: While you have an active minion, gain 25% damage reduction for 3 seconds every 8 seconds.

piercing_shot.d: Ranged projectiles have a 40% chance to pierce through the first enemy hit.

plague_bearer.d: Killing an enemy with active debuffs transfers them to the nearest enemy, refreshed at full duration.

pogo_stick.d: Falling onto an enemy stomps it and bounces you up. Stomp damage: 150% of your melee weapon's damage, or 40 damage without one. Each kill in a row without landing: +8% melee damage, up to 10 stacks. Stacks reset when you land, or after 4 seconds without a kill.

point_blank.d: Ranged hits deal +50% bonus damage when within 8 tiles of the target.

potion_rush.d: After using a healing potion, gain +10% movement speed for 4 seconds.

prismatic_fracture.d: Magic hits shatter into 3 Homing Prismatic Shards dealing 30% damage. Magic Critical Strikes release 5 shards and inflict Prismatic Daze for 3 seconds.

prolonged_surge.d: Medi Gun Overclock buffs on your ally last 12 seconds instead of 6 seconds.

queens_swarm.d: Minion hits build swarm stacks on enemies. At 5 stacks, release 6 void bugs (15 damage each) to swarm nearby enemies. The same enemy can release again after 3 seconds, and you can release once every 1 second.

quick_recovery.d: After taking damage, regenerate 6 HP over 3 seconds.

quickfire.d: Ranged weapons have a 40% chance to not consume ammo.

ravenous_swarm.d: Minion kills have a 40% chance to grant +1 max minion slot.

reforgers_patience.d: Reforging costs 20% less. You can undo your most recent reforge once, refunding the cost and restoring the previous prefix.

revitalizing_wave.d: Every 20 seconds, you start charging a magical cloud. At max 20 stacks heal all nearby teammates for 25 HP.

ricochet_engine.d: Ranged hits have a 40% chance to spawn a ricochet shot that bounces between nearby enemies. Ricochet hits trigger on-hit effects at 50% effectiveness.

riposte.d: After an enemy hits you, you have 2 seconds to land a melee hit. That hit deals +20% bonus damage based on the weapon's base damage.

run_as_administrator.d: Active: Press its hotkey for 6 seconds of no mana costs and +50% magic attack speed. Then you can't cast for 3 seconds. 25 seconds cooldown.

scapegoat.d: Every debuff a nearby teammate gets is removed from them and applied to you instead.

scavengers_luck.d: Grants +5% Fortune (World Luck & lucky trigger chance). Defeated enemies have a 40% chance to grant +15% crit chance for 5 seconds.

second_wind.d: When you fall below 25% HP, heal 40 HP. 60 seconds cooldown.

sentry_salvo.d: Sentry attacks have a 40% chance to strike a second time.

shared_dose.d: Medi Gun Overclock also restores 50% of its heal to you.

sharpshooter.d: Ranged hits deal increasing bonus damage the farther away the target is when hit, scaling up to +25% bonus damage at 400 pixels or more, based on the weapon's base damage.

shockwave.d: Melee crits release a kinetic wave that violently pushes nearby enemies away.

siege_battery.d: Every 6 seconds, each sentry also fires a siege shell at the highest-HP enemy in range for 400% of its damage, with splash.

soft_landing.d: You and nearby teammates take no fall damage while inside your support aura.

soul_link.d: Using a healing potion also heals nearby teammates for 40% of the amount healed.

soul_martyr.d: Teammates inside your aura cannot die. Any lethal damage they take is absorbed and transferred to you instead (cannot drop you below 1 HP).

spectral_guard.d: While you have 3 or more minions or sentries active at once, gain +8 defense.

spell_echo.d: 40% chance per cast to not consume any mana.

star_power.d: Picking up a Mana Star gives you Star Power for 6 seconds. Star Power: gives +25% movement speed, immunity to contact damage, and enemies you touch take damage.

steady_hands.d: Standing still continuously builds ranged crit chance, up to +20%.

stormcaller.d: Melee kills have a 40% chance to call down a lightning strike on a random nearby enemy, dealing 15% of that enemy's max HP as damage.

sugar_rush.d: Drinking Mana Potions no longer inflicts the damage penalty of Mana Sickness. Instead, excess mana grants Sugar Rush, giving decaying +15% magic damage and +10% magic crit over 5 seconds.

sunder.d: Melee crits apply Ichor for 3 seconds, reducing enemy defense briefly.

supercharger.d: Increases Medi Gun Overclock charge rate by +15%, and refunds 15% charge when Overclock is activated.

swift_return.d: On death, your respawn timer is reduced by 40%.

taunt.d: Nearby enemies preferentially target you instead of teammates.

tight_squeeze.d: Multi-projectile ranged weapons have their spread angle reduced by 45%. Striking a single enemy with 3 or more projectiles from the same blast inflicts Concussive Fracture, making it take +12% bonus ranged damage for 4 seconds.

time_warp.d: Magic crits slow all nearby enemies by 40% for 3 seconds.

pod_light.d: Your Pod becomes Pod 096 and lights up the area around you with a warm glow.

treasure_diver.d: While submerged, breath capacity is increased and kills have a 25% chance to drop bonus coins.

treasure_hunter.d: Increases pickup range for coins, hearts, and mana stars.

trick_shot.d: Arrows and bullets bounce off walls up to 3 times, gaining +30% damage per bounce. Bounced shots always crit and gain +8 armor penetration. Grants +10% velocity.

trophy_hunter.d: The first melee kill against each unique enemy type permanently grants +0.25% melee damage.

turret_syndrome.d: Permanently grants +1 max sentry slot. Active sentries become mobile hovering drones that slowly orbit around you, dealing +25% sentry damage.

twin_strike.d: Crits apply on-hit twice. Deal 15 damage on-hit, at most once every 0.3 seconds.

undying_bond.d: While you are alive and have the Support Class buff, dead teammates respawn at your location instead of their spawn point.

pod_vein.d: Your Pod becomes Pod 360. When you mine an ore, your Pod also mines up to 8 more ore tiles of the same kind touching it.

vengeance.d: When an enemy damages you, hit it back for 20 damage.

vital_echo.d: Being healed by any source grants +6 defense for 3 seconds.

void_step.d: Enemy kills grant +2% dodge chance, stacking up to +20%. Resets if 4 seconds pass without a kill.

volatile_rounds.d: Ranged hits against an enemy with any DoT effect active (Bleeding, Frostburn, Poisoned, etc.) trigger an explosion dealing 15% damage to nearby enemies.

volt_tether.d: High-voltage arcs tether you to your 2 nearest minions. Enemies caught in the electric arcs take continuous 8 summon damage and are Electrified.

wand_discipline.d: Magic weapons cost 10% less mana to use.

warcry.d: Nearby teammates gain +10% damage while you are within range.

war_gods_tempo.d: Drumbeat: melee hits landing 0.3-1.0 seconds after your last counted hit build Tempo (max 15). Each stack gives +2% melee damage. Missing the beat halves your Tempo. Conquest: melee kills add 2 Tempo. At full Tempo you raise a War Banner for 10 seconds: you and allies within 37 tiles deal +15% damage and take 10% less damage, and your melee kills release a 60 damage shockwave. 15 seconds before the next banner.

pod_trap.d: Your Pod becomes Pod 077 and flashes red when a trap is near, telling you which way it is.

whip_cracker.d: Whip hits apply a stacking debuff, increasing damage taken by 2% per stack (max 5 stacks).

whip_master.d: Whips gain +15% attack speed and +20% range.

whiplash_wave.d: When your whip cracks, a sonic wave flies out from its tip for 40% of the whip's damage. It pierces 3 enemies and triggers on-hit effects at 50% effectiveness. Wave size and distance scale with your whip's range.

wild_card.d: Grants +5% Fortune (World Luck & lucky trigger chance). Crits randomly trigger ONE of four effects, 25% chance each: heal 5 HP; +50% movement speed for 1.5 seconds; ~1 second of invincibility; or an immediate bonus strike for +20% bonus damage.

wild_magic.d: Magic attacks have a 40% chance to trigger a random Wild Surge (guaranteed on Critical Strike): • Frost Nova: Chills and deals 22 magic damage • Supernova: AOE blast dealing 32 magic damage • Chain Zap: Arc lightning jumping to 3 enemies for 26 magic damage • Mana Cascade: Restores 40 Mana • ★ JACKPOT ★: 5% chance to unleash ALL surges at once!
